principles: Fix at the exact point of need (npm test lifecycle), not by broadening scope into worktree bootstrapping.
Prefer the idiomatic npm mechanism (pretest lifecycle hook) over bespoke build orchestration.
Deterministic + idempotent: rebuilding gitignored dist yields identical bytes and never dirties the tree.
Leave a permanent, un-gameable regression guard so the utils build cannot silently regress.
Do not touch sensitive paths (worktree handler, bootstrap-runner) — keep their human-facing recovery hint intact.
drivers: done_required runs the suite via {command:npm,args:[test]}, so an npm pretest hook fires automatically before it.
Only packages/utils is missing; packages/main is already built (validate.commands[0] + needed to run full-suite-runner.js).
Scope boundary forbids editing worktree.ts and bootstrap-runner.js.

options.name: root-pretest-build-both
pros: Fires automatically on npm test via npm lifecycle (covers done_required)
One line in root package.json; mirrors existing build script
Self-bootstraps a clean tree: builds main then utils in order
dist gitignored + deterministic → no dirty tree, no build-proof conflict
cons: Adds a ~1-2 min build before every npm test
package.json in story diff → main-merge related-drift re-review risk (e5bcf07)

options.name: bootstrap-runner-autobuild
pros: Covers every bin/lattice.js call incl. interactive mid-story
cons: Auto-building inside a CLI entrypoint is surprising/magic
Parallel full-suite sub-tests would each trigger concurrent builds → races (3a09431)

options.name: worktree-handler-autobuild
pros: Fills the node_modules+dist gap at worktree creation, the most thorough
cons: Out of scope (blocked path); touches sensitive worktree bootstrapping
Adds build latency to every INIT_CHECK
Broader blast radius than the user asked for

options.name: add-utils-to-validate-commands
pros: Symmetric with existing validate.commands[0] main build
cons: Wrong target: none of the 94 validate.commands need utils; lattice validate never invokes bin/lattice.js
Would build utils where it is not needed and still miss the real npm-test path

rationale: done_required runs the full suite via the bare npm test lifecycle, so a root pretest that builds packages/main then packages/utils fires automatically and closes the gap at exactly the point utils is required — with no edits to blocked paths, no dirty tree (dist is gitignored and the build is deterministic), and no conflict with the packages-main-build proof (the pretest main build is additive and reproduces identical bytes). The rejected options are either out of scope, race-prone, or aimed at the wrong path (validate never needs utils). A fast structural smoke wired into validate.commands plus a behavioral repro-first RED that runs npm run pretest give an un-gameable, permanent guard.

preMortem.scenario: pretest builds only utils, and a truly clean tree has no packages/main/dist
preMortem.trigger: npm test invoked before any build in a fresh checkout
preMortem.consequence: npm cannot even load node packages/main/dist/tasks/full-suite-runner.js and the suite aborts before pretest value is realized
preMortem.mitigation: pretest builds packages/main FIRST, then packages/utils, making npm test fully self-bootstrapping

preMortem.scenario: package.json is part of the story diff so later main merges stale all evidence
preMortem.trigger: a sibling story lands on main (or DONE auto-bump touches package.json) before this story reaches DONE
preMortem.consequence: storyFilesHash drift forces a full TEST->DEV->REVIEW re-review round (e5bcf07)
preMortem.mitigation: work solo, close the story promptly once quorum binds, and budget one re-review round; re-run command-backed evidence rather than refresh_stale

preMortem.scenario: the regression smoke asserts a package.json string that is satisfied without the real build effect
preMortem.trigger: someone writes a pretest that echoes or no-ops the build to satisfy a naive string check
preMortem.consequence: guard passes while the utils build silently regresses
preMortem.mitigation: smoke asserts the full invariant chain (bootstrap-runner requires utils/dist; test invokes full-suite-runner; pretest actually runs both package builds, main before utils) and a behavioral RED runs npm run pretest and asserts packages/utils/dist is produced

preMortem.scenario: the behavioral RED does a destructive dist remove/restore on the shared worktree
preMortem.trigger: RED deletes packages/utils/dist then rebuilds while parallel reviewers read the same dist
preMortem.consequence: concurrent reviewers observe spurious FAILs (3a09431 race)
preMortem.mitigation: RED performs only an idempotent npm run pretest rebuild (no destructive removal of shared dist); the fast structural smoke in validate.commands does no dist mutation at all
